thread:
Priya (PM): Pushed a quick Figma for the trace drilldown headline — want the 'context summary' to surface a short error snippet + correlation pill + service + status. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz123/trace-drilldown-prop
Alex (Design): Nice — the summary feels useful. Two quick things: 1) make the correlation pill visually distinct but not too heavy, 2) truncate the error snippet to one line with a reveal on hover/click. :eyes:
Maddy (Eng): Implementation note: showing live one-line snippets per trace is fine, but expanding on hover will need a small fetch if we don't surface full message in the list view. That adds an extra request per expansion unless we preload. We should decide budget for that.
Priya (PM): Good point. For budget I'd prefer preload for the top 5 visible traces, lazy-load on scroll. That keeps the first paint fast.
Alex (Design): Can we show a tooltip for truncated text with the full error? Tooltip also helps a11y people who rely on keyboard focus.
Simon (A11y): Tooltip can work but ensure it's accessible: it should appear on :focus and be reachable via keyboard. Also make correlation pill announceable: aria-label should read the label + the full ID. Example: `aria-label="Correlation ID, 7b3f... (copy available)"` so screen readers understand there's a copy action.
Maddy (Eng): For the correlation pill copy action, I suggest we keep the copy icon visually hidden to screen readers and expose the copy as a button with `aria-label="Copy correlation ID"`. That avoids double announcements.
Alex (Design): Agreed. Also microcopy: instead of "Copy ID" use "Copy correlation ID" in the button title. And the pill itself should be clickable to open a small menu: Copy | Open in timeline | Link. Thoughts?
Priya (PM): I like pill menu. Small concern about discoverability of the menu on mobile — maybe long-press for mobile to show the menu, and click for desktop.
Maddy (Eng): Mobile long-press is ok. Backend: we should make the permalink stable and have a backend route `/trace/:id` that resolves even if the model/version changes.
Simon (A11y): Keyboard: ensure pill receives `tabindex=0` and menu is a proper popup with `role=menu` and arrow key navigation. Also add `aria-haspopup="true"` to the pill button.
Alex (Design): Placement question: where does the export action live? In the top-right of the drilldown pane or inside the correlation pill menu? I think export (download JSON / copy stack) belongs to the global drilldown toolbar, not the correlation pill menu.
Priya (PM): Export in global toolbar makes sense for bulk actions. Keep quick copy in the pill menu for single-trace actions.
Maddy (Eng): For export options, we should support two sizes: "Download trace JSON" and "Copy stack" which copies a human-readable stack string. Implementation detail: `copyStack()` should flatten frames to `file:line` lines and include correlation id at top.
Alex (Design): Copy UX: show a tiny toast "Stack copied" with an inline "Open trace" link. Keep it non-modal.
Simon (A11y): Toasts should have `role=status` and be announced. Also ensure the success message can be dismissed via keyboard and is focusable if it contains a link.
Priya (PM): On copy text itself — suggested copy content: `Correlation ID: {{id}}\nService: {{service}}\nError: {{short_message}}\n\nTrace:\n{{file1:line}}\n{{file2:line}}...` Good?
Maddy (Eng): That's great. Quick snippet for copy button we can use:
```
button.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Copy correlation ID')
navigator.clipboard.writeText(copyPayload)
```
Alex (Design): Minor visual nit: when a trace has many correlation IDs (span-level ones), should we show primary one only with a small caret to expand other IDs? I vote yes — show primary and allow expand to list others.
Priya (PM): Yes, primary + expand chevron. We should capture that in the design token: pill max-width 240px and truncation with `...`.
Simon (A11y): Make sure the expand control is reachable and announces "Expand correlation IDs, X more". Also if we show IDs as a list, each list item should be `role=listitem`.
Maddy (Eng): Last implementation nit: avoid copying long URIs directly to clipboard for the permalink; instead copy a short link via our redirect endpoint `/r/:short`. Backend can track clicks for analytics.
Priya (PM): Love the redirect idea. Can we add a small analytics event for "copy_trace_link" with plan-level tags? (low priority)
Alex (Design): One more copy tweak: For the global export menu, label entries as "Download JSON (trace)" and "Copy stack (text)" to avoid ambiguity.
Stylebot: Lint: recommended contrast for pill text on #ffffff background -> pill background should be >= 4.5:1 for normal text. Suggest `#0B57D2` on white or add subtle border.
Simon (A11y): +1 on contrast.
Priya (PM): Ok actionable list: 1) Design to update Figma with pill menu + truncated snippet + export toolbar placement (Alex) 2) Eng to prototype copy behavior and toast (Maddy) 3) A11y to write acceptance checks for keyboard flow and ARIA (Simon) 4) PM to scope preload/lazy-load decision and shortlink backend (Priya)
Alex (Design): I'll update the Figma and add notes for mobile long-press and pill max-width. Expect update by EOD. :thumbsup:
Maddy (Eng): I'll spike the copy/permalink shortlink tomorrow and post a prototype link in this thread. :rocket:
Simon (A11y): I'll draft acceptance criteria and keyboard flows later today.
Priya (PM): Thanks all — feel free to drop quick comments on the Figma file rather than replies here to keep this thread focused. :heart:
